candidateEvaluations.strategy: A comprehensive mixed-profile rewards screen featuring 9 rich components: POINTS_BALANCE, four individual GOAL_PROGRESS_CARD elements for each active goal (Bali Trip, New Laptop, Retirement Fund, Home Deposit), an ADD_GOAL_CARD, GOAL_LINKED_REWARD, FUTURE_VALUE_CARD, PROJECTION_CHART, CHALLENGE_CARD, STREAK_CARD, and LEADERBOARD. Perfectly balances gamification telemetry with long-term financial milestones.

customerGoalRelevance.explanation: Directly addresses all 4 savings goals plus gamification elements, adhering strictly to multi-goal card rules.

expectedCustomerUtility.explanation: Delivers high utility by pairing immediate community/streak elements with detailed long-term financial progress.

rewardProfileAlignment.explanation: Directly matches the PROGRESS_AND_COMMUNITY motivation profile.

accessibilityAndCognitiveFit.explanation: Structured layout with clear visual hierarchy, avoiding cognitive overload while incorporating rich components.

evidenceConfidence.explanation: Backed by complete and high-confidence intelligence layer data.

brandAndDesignConsistency.explanation: Follows all design system principles and brand guidelines without logo/text modification.

usefulNovelty.explanation: Blends short-term challenge mechanics with future value projections seamlessly.

operationalFeasibility.explanation: All components are fully supported within the mobile app schema and available widget library.

candidateEvaluations.strategy: A streamlined rewards screen focusing primarily on gamification elements (STREAK_CARD, CHALLENGE_CARD, LEADERBOARD, POINTS_BALANCE) along with a consolidated GOAL_PROGRESS_CARD and FUTURE_VALUE_CARD.

customerGoalRelevance.explanation: Fails to provide individual cards for all 4 distinct active savings goals as mandated for multi-goal customers.

expectedCustomerUtility.explanation: Good engagement focus, but underdelivers on long-term goal tracking depth.

rewardProfileAlignment.explanation: Leans heavily into gamification while short-changing steady long-term saving.

accessibilityAndCognitiveFit.explanation: Simpler layout but misses holistic multi-goal visibility.

evidenceConfidence.explanation: Uses available intelligence data but underutilizes goal breadth.

usefulNovelty.explanation: Standard gamification layout with low novelty.

objections: Multi-goal customers must see one card per goal plus an ADD_GOAL_CARD. Candidate-2 consolidates goals and omits the add goal card, violating UI rules.

allCandidates.strategy: A comprehensive mixed-profile rewards screen for Priya Sharma featuring mandatory anchored points balance, four individual GOAL_PROGRESS_CARD elements for each active savings goal (Bali Trip, New Laptop, Retirement Fund, Home Deposit), an ADD_GOAL_CARD, plus robust gamification components (STREAK_CARD, CHALLENGE_CARD, LEADERBOARD) and projection elements.
